name: PC-3 re-test: EXP-006 criteria and same-channel reference unchanged, plus a Monte Carlo precision rule (decides the PC-3 gate; EXP-001, EXP-005, EXP-006 stay FAIL)
decision: Josue 2026-10-10, decision card 'EXP-007 with precision'; 11 LOG-2026-10-10-PC3-EXP007
status_of_criteria: EXP-006 criteria unchanged; only the precision rule and the number of windows are new (the EXP-006 failure was Monte Carlo noise above the margin); fresh seeds; frozen and pushed before the run

synthetic_design.background: independent per channel, Gaussian with 1/f power spectrum (exponent 1), no inter-channel coupling
synthetic_design.reference: CAR over the 19 channels, as in the real pipeline
synthetic_design.window_starts_s: 6 + 3k (k = 0..n_windows-1); the first and last 4 s of each recording are never used

lag_test.lag_sign_meaning: +1: channel j lags channel i (expected sign of sum Im(z_i conj z_j) > 0); -1: i lags j
lag_test.lag: integer-sample delay nearest to a quarter period at the band centre (theta 6, alpha 10.5, beta 21.5 Hz)
lag_test.burst: band-limited Gaussian noise (same Butterworth order-4 band-pass) times a 1.6-s Hann taper centred in each window; the delayed copy is added to the lagging channel
lag_test.snr_meaning: burst RMS over the taper's non-zero span = snr x the source channel's in-band background RMS

blocks.meaning: each block is a fresh synthetic recording with the lag-test design (100 s, 30 windows); windows pool across blocks
blocks.stopping_rule: after the initial blocks and after each increment, stop when every excess comparison's Monte Carlo SE <= 0.005; the rule looks only at SEs, never at the excess values

seeds.block_seeding: numpy default_rng([seed, band index, block index])
seeds.surrogates: 06 section 4.3 step 8 rule with eeg_id 'SYN7-LAG-<band>-B<block, 3 digits>' or 'SYN7-NULL-<band>'

same_channel_reference.definition: per window, realisation r and channel c of a coupled pair: wPLI between the FC_surr IAAFT surrogate of c (seed rule, eeg_id 'SYN7-LAG-<band>-B<block>') and a second, independent IAAFT surrogate of c (eeg_id 'SYN7-LAG-<band>-B<block>-REF'); window Hilbert; averaged over realisations and windows
same_channel_reference.meaning: wPLI produced by single-channel properties alone (spectrum and amplitude distribution), with no coupling by construction

surrogate_destruction.lag_direction_at_chance: per coupled edge, the share of windows x realisations whose surrogate sum Im(z_i conj z_j) has the injected sign lies in [0.35, 0.65] (chance 0.5; 150 draws, SE 0.041)
surrogate_destruction.excess_definition: per coupled edge (a, b) and for each of its channels c in {a, b}: mean over windows of k-averaged FC_surr wPLI on (a, b) minus the same-channel reference of c; every value must be <= 0.02

precision.se_definition: SD over windows of the per-window excess (k-averaged FC_surr wPLI on the coupled edge minus the k-averaged same-channel reference of channel c), divided by sqrt(number of windows)

null_coupling_match.offset: per window: mean over 171 edges of real wPLI minus mean of k-averaged surrogate wPLI; 95% t-interval over windows

reported_not_criteria: EXP-001 checks (coupled vs all uncoupled edges)

result_rule.PASS: every criterion holds in every primary band and every excess SE <= 0.005
result_rule.FAIL: any criterion fails at the stopping point (for the excess: any point estimate > 0.02)
result_rule.INDETERMINATE: all point estimates meet the criteria but some excess SE > 0.005 at the maximum of 120 blocks; returned to Josue
